title: Cobblemon ThePokeRealm
description: ThePokeRealm is a No-P2W Cobblemon Server that thrives on it's amazing, friendly community that aspires to keep improving with each update adding more content for it's players!
body:
The official ThePokeRealm Server - Fabric 1.21.1! 
ThePokeRealm is a lightweight Cobblemon experience tailored for performance, immersion, and quality-of-life improvements. This server enhances the core gameplay without overwhelming you with unnecessary mods.

Whether you're exploring, battling, or building, everything included is carefully chosen to support a smooth and engaging Cobblemon journey.

Let's talk about our wide array of features, what do we offer?
ZERO P2W
ZERO GAMBLING
Mega Evolution
Dynamax
